description: Lists the jobs at Modulos that are open for application through this server, with a short public summary of each and, when a role has one, its work_location: candidates must be based in, and allowed to work in, it. Applications for these roles are not accepted by email. The full job description of a role is available from get_job_description. The result also holds open_application: when it is not null, a person for whom none of the roles fits can send Modulos an open application with start_open_application.
name: list_open_roles
